review_scope: Static source and schema inspection only; no imports, scientific execution, data re-statistics, remote access, or transfer.

interfaces.name: build_recovery_manifest
interfaces.signature: build_recovery_manifest(records_by_seed: Mapping[Any, Mapping[str, Any]], *, config: Any = None) -> dict[str, Any]
interfaces.input_contract: Exactly the fixed 16 old-D diagnostic records, keyed by seed; config must describe the accepted fixed cohort, five recovery seeds, 11 reuse cases, lambda 1, labels V/UG/UR, and the frozen selection rules.
interfaces.nested_schema: replays uses decimal-string seed keys. Each value contains format, F64, U64, same_float64_candidate, reuse_eligible, recovery_required, original_float32_identity, path_sha256, closure_count, and seed. F64/U64 are scalar records (index, fullL, newKL, oldKL, ridge, candidate_hash); original_float32_identity contains fallback_applied, selected_float32_candidate_sha256, candidate_sha256, prepared_id, and seed. No candidate arrays are returned.
interfaces.selection_basis: Exact F64/U64 candidate hashes plus the original float32 fallback status. Holdout, C0 markers, new probe outcomes, and score values do not choose recovery seeds.

interfaces.name: lock_cohort
interfaces.signature: lock_cohort(manifest: Mapping[str, Any], recovered_locks: Mapping[Any, Any], reuse_bindings: Mapping[Any, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]
interfaces.input_contract: The verified recovery manifest; exactly five recovered entries in locked_probe_manifest form; the complete H036 ACCEPTANCE_BINDINGS_V1 JSON object.
interfaces.nested_schema: format is h036_acceptance_cohort_v1. cases uses decimal-string keys for all 16 seeds. Each case contains seed, reuse, logical_case, prepared_id, path_sha256, lock_sha256, binding, inputs, foundation, v1_source_identity_sha256, arms, and probes. Recovered cases carry locked V/UG/UR source and candidate identities; reused cases point each label to the original D metrics score_ref. Candidate arrays are not returned.

interfaces.name: make_anchor_permit
interfaces.return_values: format=h036_acceptance_stage_permit_v1; stage=anchor. The embedded cohort is the complete verified cohort lock. The stage permits only V scoring for the five recovery cases.

interfaces.name: confirm_anchors
interfaces.signature: confirm_anchors(cohort: Mapping[str, Any], anchor_scores: Mapping[Any, Any], expected_metrics_bytes: Mapping[Any, bytes], reuse_bindings: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]
interfaces.input_contract: Exactly five V score records and five original D metrics files as raw bytes, keyed by recovery seed, plus the exact bindings object. Each score record needs metrics and deployment.actor_bytes (raw 89-byte actor bytes); deployment itself may alternatively be raw bytes.
interfaces.checks: Verifies old metrics raw byte count/SHA against the bound D artifact, 89-byte actor identity, prepared/candidate/foundation identities, exact canonical pre_codec_fresh, encoded_fresh, and W0_fresh objects, and exact G_new, K_new, K_new_W0, K_old fields. Resource/timing fields and the complete new metrics-file SHA are not compared.
interfaces.return_values: format=h036_acceptance_stage_permit_v1; stage=counterfactual. anchors_pass_token binds cohort_lock_sha256 and has exactly five records, each with expected_metrics_sha, actual_metrics_canonical_sha, actor_sha, plus token_sha256.

interfaces.name: validate_stage_permit
interfaces.signature: validate_stage_permit(permit: Mapping[str, Any], locked: Mapping[str, Any], label: str) -> None
interfaces.behavior: Checks permit and cohort digests, the full locked identity, recovery seed, and label-stage pairing. Anchor allows V only; counterfactual allows UG/UR only and requires the all-five anchor token.

interfaces.name: locked_probe_manifest
interfaces.nested_schema: probes has exactly V, UG, UR. Each entry contains source metadata, candidate_sha256 (scientific helper identity), and raw_sha256 (exact float32 candidate-byte identity). The manifest is JSON-safe and deliberately excludes NumPy arrays.

interfaces.name: encode_and_score_locked_probe
interfaces.signature: encode_and_score_locked_probe(prepared: dict[str, Any], locked_probe: dict[str, Any], label: str, *, stage_permit: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]
interfaces.input_contract: A prepared h036_prepared_v1 object, the full in-memory lock (including arrays), label V/UG/UR, and a permit issued by replay. It validates prepared input/foundation identities against the cohort before invoking the original wildcard scorer.
interfaces.return_schema: The original scoring result with metrics and deployment payload, plus diagnostic_only=true and selection_source. selection_source contains label, selector, origin_index, candidate_origin_index, post_cast_gate_enabled, post_cast_gate_pass, fallback_applied, candidate_sha256, raw_sha256, trace_sha256, lock_sha256, cohort_lock_sha256, and stage. Preserve deployment.actor_bytes, checkpoint_bytes, and evidence_bytes verbatim when present; checkpoint bytes must not be serialized again.

array_and_bytes_contract.selection_trace: candidates contains only C0/F64/U64 float64 arrays, each shape (3,3), C-order little-endian raw size 72 bytes. Scalar diagnostics and hashes are JSON-safe; the trace as a whole is not directly JSON-serializable.
array_and_bytes_contract.locked_probes: Each of V/UG/UR contains candidate and raw_cast_candidate float32 arrays, each shape (3,3), C-order little-endian raw size 36 bytes. candidate is the final post-gate point; raw_cast_candidate is the pre-fallback cast. Preserve both arrays and all non-array lock metadata.
array_and_bytes_contract.hashes: candidate_sha256 is the scientific helper hash over dtype.str, NUL, repr(shape), NUL, and C-order bytes. raw_sha256 is SHA-256 of canonical C-order raw array bytes only. They are distinct identities and neither replaces the other.
array_and_bytes_contract.deployment: Actor, checkpoint, and evidence bytes returned by the original scorer are deployment artifacts; persist them verbatim. Do not re-run torch.save on returned checkpoint bytes.
